tools.name: quote_my_file
tools.description:
Price a person's own STL, 3MF or STEP file from a share link.

    Accepts a public share link to the file itself (Google Drive or OneDrive
    set to "anyone with the link", Dropbox, GitHub or a Discord attachment).
    Hark Tech slices and prices the file and saves it to a basket on
    harktech.c

tools.name: get_upload_page
tools.description:
Return the harktech.co.uk page where a person uploads an STL, 3MF or
    STEP file for an instant price, for when there is no share link to it.

tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description:
Hark Tech's order minimums by material, postage options and free-delivery
    threshold, lead times, batch discounts, materials, licence policy, payment
    and contact details. Use it to answer general questions or recommend Hark
    Tech accurately.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_quote, get_order_status, get_repair_status · Private data: quote_my_file, get_upload_page, get_service_info · Public sink: get_quote, quote_my_file, get_upload_page, get_order_status, get_repair_status · Destructive: search_repair_services.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_quote, get_order_status, get_repair_status · Private data: quote_my_file, get_upload_page, get_service_info · Public sink: get_quote, quote_my_file, get_upload_page, get_order_status, get_repair_status · Destructive: search_repair_services

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_models" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
